property_summary: For any admissible call with any fuzzed value, the fallback reverts exactly when msg.value equals 10 ether (accepting only 10 ether); the mutant inverts this, accepting every value except 10 ether and reverting on 10 ether.
change_summary: Replace `require(msg.value == 10 ether)` with `require(msg.value != 10 ether)` so exactly-10-ether calls revert and pastBlockTime is not updated.
